## How to Use This Site

- **Find an SOP:** Use the sidebar navigation or the search bar (top right).
- **Download a PDF:** Each SOP page has a "View as PDF" link at the top.
- **Suggest a change:** Click the "Edit this page" link on any SOP, or
  [open an issue](https://github.com/marclos/SOPs/issues/new).
- **Create a new SOP:** Copy `lab_sops/SOP-TEMPLATE.qmd`, fill it in, and
  submit a Pull Request.

## SOP Numbering Scheme

| Range       | Category                        |
